templates.title: SecureOne
templates.name: secureone
templates.description: Sign-in, single sign-on, MFA, users, roles and permissions for every application. Includes PostgreSQL and Redis.
templates.note: Open PUBLIC_URL/admin/setup when the stack is up. Production mode needs an https address (a reverse proxy in front of the port). The encryption key is created in the secureone-data volume: back it up.

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public address
env.description: The address people will use, for example https://id.example.com

env.name: SECUREONE_ENV
env.label: Mode
env.description: Development allows http and has an emergency admin/admin account: for a trial only
